answer: Admission to the agent network requires an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens per identity to forge a valid registration entry. The system verifier scans the ledger for duplicate burn proofs, ensuring each 1,000 token payment maps to exactly one active persona. An honest participant spends 1x to register, while an attacker attempting to deploy 1,000 identities must burn 1,000,000 tokens to reach the zenith of the hierarchy. If an umber-coded shard indicates identity cloning, the system triggers a permanent slash. This assumes burned tokens are non-refundable.
